article.headline: Woods scores 28, Niagara beats Delaware State 103-101 in OT
article.description: — Logan Woods’ 28 points helped Niagara defeat Delaware State 103-101 in overtime on Friday.
article.linkText: Woods scores 28, Niagara beats Delaware State 103-101 in OT

categories.description: Niagara Purple Eagles @ Delaware State Hornets

event.description: Niagara Purple Eagles @ Delaware State Hornets

keywords: Niagara Purple Eagles @ Delaware State Hornets
article.story: DOVER, Del. -- — Logan Woods’ 28 points helped Niagara defeat Delaware State 103-101 in overtime on Friday. Vukasin Todorovic's layup with 11 seconds left in overtime decided it. Woods added five rebounds, seven assists, and five steals for the Purple Eagles (1-4). Cole Farrell scored 24 points and added three steals. Samuele Miccoli shot 6 of 14 from the field, including 1 for 5 from 3-point range, and went 6 for 9 from the line to finish with 19 points. Nasir Muhammad finished with 30 points and six assists for the Hornets (2-4). Joshua Obiora added 28 points and 11 rebounds for Delaware State. Isaiah Sullivan also had 20 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
